tools.name: helixar_inspect_mcp
tools.description: Scan MCP servers (URLs or raw manifest JSON) against Helixar's Sentinel detection rules. Returns risk scores, findings, and a security brief. Quick mode runs eight rules without a key. Deep mode runs all 32 Sentinel rules plus composition checks with an api_key.

target.description: MCP server URL or raw manifest JSON string

targets.description: Two to ten MCP server URLs or raw manifest JSON strings, including up to three URLs

tools.name: helixar_hdp_validate
tools.description: Validate an HDP delegation chain against IETF draft-helixar-hdp-agentic-delegation-00. Surfaces scope escalations, depth violations, expired hops, missing signatures. Every output cites the IETF draft and Zenodo DOI.

tools.name: helixar_hdp_verify
tools.description: Verify a Human Delegation Provenance (HDP) token offline with the issuer's Ed25519 public key. Reports whether the signatures and chain are intact, which integrity step failed, and the recording period. Optional explanations may use the configured narration service. Cites the IETF draft and Zenodo DOI.

tools.name: helixar_check_auth
tools.description: Check a public HTTPS MCP endpoint for OAuth metadata, PKCE, resource indicators, dynamic client registration, and CORS signals. Reports eight checks with evidence and references.
